newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hizbollah kills two Israeli soldiers in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Hizbollah kills two Israeli soldiers in Lebanon.

text.p: Iranian-backed Hizbollah guerrillas killed two Israeli soldiers and seriously wounded two others on Tuesday in a bomb attack in the Jewish state's south Lebanon occupation zone, the Israeli army said.
"Two Israeli soldiers were killed and two soldiers were wounded seriously by a roadside bomb that activated against an Israeli army force in the south Lebanon security zone," it said in a communique.

Hizbollah, the Party of God, claimed responsibility for the attack. Pro-Israeli militia sources said the blast occurred as Israeli soldiers were travelling on the road between Marqaba and Odeissi deep in the central sector of the zone.
Tuesday's casualties brought to 27 the number of Israeli soldiers killed in south Lebanon so far this year, four more than last year's total.

Hizbollah's military wing, the Islamic Resistance, is committed to ousting Israeli troops from the 15-km (nine-mile) south Lebanon border area. On December 7, Hizbollah guerrillas killed one Israeli soldier and wounded two in a similar attack.
Military censors in Israel held up publication of the news for several hours pending notification of the soldiers' families.
